events.title: The Waterboys (with Ella Hooper) — Live at The Tivoli
events.description: Celtic rock legends The Waterboys, joined by Ella Hooper, play an intimate gig at The Tivoli. Expect sweeping, poetic live music and a strong atmosphere from their devoted following.

events.title: Warren Zeiders — World Tour 2026
events.description: American country/rock artist Warren Zeiders brings his raw and atmospheric live performance to Fortitude Music Hall for two nights, showcasing his growing cult following.

events.title: Ivan Aristeguieta — 'Ready to Mambo' Comedy Show
events.description: Venezuelan-Australian comedian Ivan Aristeguieta presents his sharp, culturally layered stand-up show 'Ready To Mambo' as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival's final week.

events.title: The Fairbairns — 'Fair Dinkum'
events.description: Australian act The Fairbairns perform their intimate, guitar-driven music show 'Fair Dinkum' at The Tivoli, ideal for curious music lovers seeking a unique sound.

events.title: Luke Heggie — 'I Won't Say It Again' Stand-Up Comedy
events.description: Critically acclaimed Australian stand-up comedian Luke Heggie brings his show 'I Won't Say It Again' to The Tivoli, known for his dry, intelligent wit and deadpan delivery.

events.title: Hanumankind — OTW Tour
events.description: Indian-American rapper Hanumankind performs his high-energy 'OTW Tour' at The Princess Theatre, bringing his unique sound and cultural buzz to Brisbane.

events.title: KT Tunstall — Eye to the Telescope 20th Anniversary Tour
events.description: Scottish singer-songwriter KT Tunstall celebrates the 20th anniversary of her landmark album 'Eye to the Telescope' with an intimate, emotional, and deeply musical performance.

events.title: Of Monsters and Men — The Mouse Parade Tour
events.description: Icelandic indie-folk band Of Monsters and Men return with new music, promising gorgeous layered vocals and an evocative atmosphere at Fortitude Music Hall.

events.title: Enter Shikari (with grandson)
events.description: UK's politically charged, genre-defying post-hardcore/electronic act Enter Shikari performs with grandson at The Tivoli, attracting a fiercely thoughtful fanbase for an intellectually exciting live show.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Final Week
events.location: Various venues (Brisbane Powerhouse, The Tivoli, Fortitude Music Hall, The Princess Theatre)
events.description: The final week of the Brisbane Comedy Festival showcases local and international stand-up, improv, sketch, and burlesque across multiple venues, including a ruthless office satire by Charles Firth of The Chaser.

events.title: HSBC German Film Festival
events.location: Palace Cinemas, James Street, Fortitude Valley (and other Palace locations)
events.description: The 2026 HSBC German Film Festival presents a curated selection of contemporary German, Austrian, and Swiss cinema, direct from major European festivals, including the award-winning legal thriller 'Prosecution'.

events.title: IMA Platform 2026 Exhibition
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: The IMA's annual Platform exhibition showcases new ambitious projects by emerging Queensland artists Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff, exploring themes like AI, online subcultures, and surrealism.

events.title: IMA — 'Free Range 6' Thursday Sound Club
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Ground Floor Gallery, Fortitude Valley
events.description: The IMA's 'Free Range 6' Thursday Sound Club features local treasure SCRAPS (Laura Hill) performing her signature blend of hazy club beats and keyboard pop, offering a unique underground music experience.

events.title: Open Mic Comedy Night
events.description: A recurring weekly open mic comedy night MC'd by Rhi Down at The Newmarket Hotel, offering a chance to discover emerging talent and mingle with a relaxed, curious crowd.

events.title: The Sit Down Comedy Club — Multiple Shows
events.location: The Sit Down Comedy Club, Paddington
events.description: Brisbane's beloved Sit Down Comedy Club hosts multiple stand-up shows this week, including 'The Mitzi Project' and 'Comedy Allsorts', offering an intimate venue to enjoy rotating lineups and connect with comedy-loving locals.

events.title: Paniyiri Greek Festival — 50th Anniversary
events.description: Brisbane's Paniyiri Greek Festival celebrates its 50th anniversary, offering two days of authentic Greek food, music, dance, and cultural celebration, drawing a large, vibrant community crowd to Musgrave Park.

events.title: HSBNE Hackerspace — Tuesday Open Night
events.description: Visit HSBNE, Brisbane's community-driven makerspace, during their weekly Tuesday Open Night. Explore projects in woodworking, electronics, 3D printing, and more, and connect with curious, hands-on individuals.
